jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.jd_full:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (AI-native, Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Description

About ShortPoint

ShortPoint is a design software company that helps teams build beautiful intranet sites inside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team certified as a Great Place to Work and ranked #4 out of 15 Best Workplaces in Technology in the GCC, with regional offices in Dubai, Lviv, Ann Arbor, and London. We believe teamwork makes the dream work, and we keep our teams in sync and winning at scale. We are looking for a meticulous, proactive, and technically grounded Technical Product Manager to join our product team and work directly with our Product Director to keep our product engine running with precision and a great eye for design.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Product Manager to support the Product Director across the full product lifecycle. You will run and manage product meetings, turn ideas and discussions into clear, well-written user stories, create mockups with the help of modern AI tools, and keep everyone informed on the status of upcoming releases.

The ideal candidate combines strong product craft with genuine design sensibility and a solid technical foundation: you can follow engineering discussions with ease, reason about APIs and architecture, and dig into technical details when the situation calls for it. The stronger your technical depth, the better. You will bridge the gap between engineering, UI/UX design, and business priorities, and you should be comfortable working AI-first across your daily workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Assist with the day-to-day product cadence alongside the Product Director, from meeting management and follow-ups through backlog grooming, story writing, and release tracking.

  • Story Writing: Write detailed, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria in Linear, and keep the backlog organized and sprint-ready.

  • Release Communication: Track release progress across engineering and QA, and proactively inform stakeholders of status, risks, and timelines.

  • AI-Assisted Design: Create wireframes and mockups using AI design and prototyping tools, and apply a strong eye for UI/UX to keep the product intuitive and polished (you will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview)

  • AI Process Improvement: Being able to contribute to our processes by utilizing AI (Claude/ChatGPT work) to analyze data, close gaps, and resolve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

⚠️ Mandatory Screening Criteria: Candidates who do not meet the experience and background requirements below will not be considered.

  • Total Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on product management experience specifically within software/SaaS environments

  • Industry Background: Must have direct experience working on B2B SaaS products; familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or intranet products is a strong plus

  • Tools & Ecosystems: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with Linear (or a similar agile tracking tool), GitHub, and Claude (CLI and app) or comparable AI tooling

  • Design Literacy: Strong eye for design, foundational knowledge of UI/UX workflows, and proven ability to produce mockups with AI-assisted tools

  • Technical Foundation: A solid technical background with strong software development familiarity; able to hold your own in discussions about APIs, web technologies, and architecture with engineers. Deeper hands-on experience, such as with JavaScript/React or the Microsoft 365/SharePoint ecosystem, is a significant advantage

  • Include the word ‘compass’ in your application response to confirm you have read this posting carefully.

  • Big Plus: A Claude Code or Codex project of your own that you can showcase and explain in the interview

  • Location: Fully remote role; work from anywhere with reasonable overlap with the team

jobs.title: Hardware Product Manager, Global - Remote
jobs.jd_full:
CVEDIA · Remote, anywhere (with overlap with European afternoons) · Full-time

(This job requires Advanced English (C1) proficiency - with the ability to communicate fluently and handle complex, fast-paced technical and professional tasks.)

About CVEDIA

CVEDIA builds AI video analytics for physical security, smart cities and defense. We train our own models, and we make them run about ten times more efficiently than our competitors, which makes every appliance far more cost-effective. Our models already run in real products on server and edge hardware around the world, and we ship them on our own appliances, from edge hubs to rack servers.

About the role

We need someone to own that hardware line globally: the suppliers who build it, the partners who distribute it, and the story that sells it. Our appliances have to win on their own merits, so you will decide what we build, who builds it, where it sells and at what price.

You will report to our CTO and to our Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with our engineers on what goes into each appliance. There is a lot to handle at the same time, and you will own all of it and set the priorities.

In your first months you will get to know our appliances, our suppliers and our software, and then turn them into a line we can sell worldwide. That means choosing the suppliers who can build at global scale, setting up how new hardware is tested and qualified before it ships, and picking the first distribution partners in each region.

If you have taken hardware from spec to shelf and know how to work with manufacturers and distributors, keep reading.

What you will do

  • Own our relationships with system builders, ODMs and component vendors, including pricing, lead times, quality and continuity of supply.
  • Decide which appliances belong in the lineup, when a new one comes in, and when an old one is retired.
  • Build distribution across North America, Europe, LATAM and the Middle East, choosing the partners and the terms in each region.
  • Lead hardware product marketing, from positioning and datasheets to launches and the tools our channel partners use to sell.
  • Keep pricing, margins and inventory healthy, so that every appliance we sell earns its place in the lineup.
  • Work with our engineers on CPU, GPU and storage choices, so that each appliance runs our models well at the right cost.

You may be a good fit if

  • You have five or more years of experience in hardware product management.
  • You have managed contract manufacturers or system builders directly, from the first specification through production.
  • You have launched hardware products that sold at a healthy margin, and you can tell us the numbers.

It would be great if you

  • Have worked in physical security, IT infrastructure or edge computing.
  • Have built or run distribution in more than one region.
  • Can discuss CPU, GPU and storage tradeoffs with engineers in enough depth to question their choices.
  • Have worked in a company that changed direction when its market did, and helped it adjust.

You do not need to tick every box. If you have taken hardware to market and want to own a whole line, we would like to hear from you.

Why CVEDIA

  • You own it. There are no layers of approval and no committee between you and the supplier. You see the problem, you make the call, and we back you.
  • A product role. You decide how our appliances win, from what goes in the lineup to how it is priced and sold, rather than only buying what others specify.
  • A running start. You inherit a real lineup with real demand, not a blank page.
  • Direct influence. We are a small team, so you will work directly with all of us and see the effect of your decisions quickly.

Where and how you work

  • We are fully remote and have no offices. We meet in person once a year at a company meetup, usually in Europe.
  • You need to overlap with European afternoons for our team meetings.
  • Partners in four regions sometimes need an early morning or a late evening call, so you need some flexibility in your hours.
  • Pay depends on your experience.

How to apply

Please submit your resume/CV in English. Tell us about one hardware product you took to market: what you decided, what went wrong, and how it sold.

The interview process is a few calls with our managers.

CVEDIA welcomes applicants from every background and country. We judge your work, not your title or your path to it.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Remote Dallas/Fort Worth, TX
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Chord Design Studio is a remote architecture and interiors firm focused on highly detailed, financially controlled, well-coordinated projects. Our work includes hospitality, restaurants, breweries, wineries, boutique hotels, aviation, multifamily, commercial, mixed-use, and select custom residential projects. We operate with direct communication, high standards, and strong project ownership so our clients, consultants, and internal team know what needs to happen next.

We Value: Balance, Transparency, Innovation

Job Description

As the newest member of our talented team, you will play a vital role in directing projects through design, documentation, and coordination. You’re a licensed architect with 10+ years of project leadership and project management experience. You catch coordination issues early, push consultants for real answers, and give clients straight information. You’re comfortable being the face of a project — delivering good news and hard news the same way, and holding your ground when scope, schedule, or budget need protecting. You know when a technical issue calls for the CEO’s involvement, and you see that as good judgment, not a limitation. If you’re ready for a role where your judgment, follow-through, and project ownership set the standard for the team around you, let’s talk!

You Value: Leadership, Predictability, Quality

How you’ll spend your day:

  • Leading small and midsize projects, and supporting the CEO on larger or more complex ones, from early design through construction administration

  • Reviewing drawings, specifications, and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and constructability
  • Directing full trade coordination across structural, MEP, civil, and other consultants
  • Tracking schedules, budgets, consultant deliverables, and client decision points
  • Managing construction administration, including RFIs, submittals, ASIs/addenda, field observations, and open issue tracking with CEO input on complex issues
  • Mentoring Project Architects, Designers, and other team members while holding the team accountable to deadlines and quality expectations
  • Traveling to project sites up to 30% depending on project and firm needs

Qualifications

What you bring to the table:

  • A licensed architect with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture
  • 10+ years of professional architectural experience, including 5+ years in a project manager role - hospitality, aviation, or restaurant experience is a strong plus
  • At least 3 years of construction administration experience, including full lifecycle responsibility on assigned projects
  • Strong technical detailing skills, with deep experience coordinating construction documents across structural, MEP, civil, and other trades
  • Advanced Revit proficiency and solid technical knowledge of construction methods, detailing, and code coordination
  • Clear, confident communication with clients, consultants, contractors, and your internal team
  • A portfolio of work demonstrating your project leadership and technical detailing
  • NCARB Certification, Autodesk Forma/Construction Cloud experience, and Deltek Vantagepoint experience are all pluses
  • Based in the Dallas metro area, within 50 miles of DFW International or Love Field airports

Additional Information

What you’ll enjoy when you join us:

  • Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus eligibility
  • A nice suite of benefits and remote work arrangement
  • Opportunity to gain experience in a variety of project types

Goldstone Partners is helping this successful, growing firm find seasoned pros to join us. Applications welcomed from US Citizens and Green Card holders only.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Data Society Group

At Data Society Group, we provide the highest quality, leading-edge, industry-tailored data and AI training and solutions for Fortune 1,000 companies and federal, state, and local governmental organizations. We partner with our clients to educate, equip, and empower their workforces with the skills they need to achieve their goals and expand their impact. Our portfolio of brands and services sits at the intersection of people, data, and AI and consists of:

  • CDO Magazine, the trusted voice of global data and AI leadership
  • The Data Lodge, a pioneer in data literacy and cultural transformation
  • Data Society, delivering applied AI education and custom-built solutions
  • InspiredMinds!, a convening force behind the world’s most inclusive AI community

We are working to empower the workforces of the future; if you’re as passionate about transforming workplaces with the power of Data & AI as we are, we’d love to hear from you!

Role Overview

The Technical Project Manager is responsible for the day-to-day delivery management of a complex, multi-workstream enterprise software implementation for a fast-paced client. This role runs the full delivery team (both onshore and offshore) ensuring sprint cadence, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery governance operate smoothly across all phases. The ideal candidate is highly resourceful and comfortable pushing back when necessary to maintain scope, timelines, and project integrity.

Working under the direction of the Program Manager, the Project Manager serves as the operational hub of the engagement. You will own the program plan, track issues and risks, coordinate with the technology implementation team on dependencies, and contribute to both internal and client-facing status reporting.

This is a full-time W2 position (can also be contracted through your company if preferred) on a fixed-term engagement currently ending March 2027, with a possibility of converting into a permanent role based on performance and client needs. This role is work-from-home (remote) though must be able to commute to client offices in Falls Church, VA as needed (estimated every 2 weeks).

Responsibilities

As the Project Manager, you will lead daily execution, drive cross-functional alignment, and enforce project governance. Your primary duties include:

  • Delivery Team & Schedule Management: Own day-to-day project tracking across all workstreams, maintaining the program plan, monitoring milestones, and flagging risks or schedule variances to the Program Manager. Direct onshore and offshore team members across all workstreams to ensure clarity on priorities, blockers, and deliverables.
  • Risk Management & Governance: Capture, track, and drive resolution for all risks and issues via the risk and issue log. Enforce the RACI matrix and governance cadence to ensure decision-making and escalation paths are followed and documented.
  • Sprint Operations & Team Coordination: Facilitate sprint planning and retrospective logistics, track velocity, and maintain backlog hygiene in the project management tool. Coordinate with offshore team leads on capacity, blockers, and status, escalating to the Program Manager when necessary.
  • Technology Implementation Alignment: Coordinate directly with the technology implementation team on project-related topics, dependencies, and integration touchpoints, escalating program-level decisions as needed.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Draft content for client-facing and internal status reports for Program Manager review. Maintain all program documentation—including meeting notes, decision logs, and delivery artifacts—ensuring assets remain current and accessible.
  • Onboarding, Scope & Readiness Support: Coordinate system access, environment provisioning, and onboarding logistics for new onshore and offshore team members. Support scope change documentation by tracking scope decisions against the program plan and budget. Track go/no-go checklist items and ensure owner accountability ahead of cutover.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–8 years of technical project management experience, with at least 3 years spent on enterprise software delivery engagements.
  • Demonstrable experience running hybrid onshore/offshore delivery teams across multiple time zones.
  • Strong proficiency with Jira, sprint management, backlog grooming, reporting, and dashboard configuration.
  • Proven experience managing risk and issue logs, program plans, and delivery governance on multi-workstream programs.
  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies, sprint ceremonies, velocity tracking, and iterative delivery cadences.
  • Experience contributing to client-facing status reports and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience coordinating with third-party technology implementation teams on project dependencies and integration touchpoints.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to assist with documentation drafting, status reporting, meeting summarization, and program tracking (AI-assisted productivity is standard practice on this engagement).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to draft clear, concise status reports and communicate delivery status effectively to both internal and client stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and extreme attention to detail, with a proven ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams seamlessly.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with bi-weekly sprint cycles and frequent stakeholder touchpoints, demonstrating strong resourcefulness and the confidence to push back effectively when needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent formal project management certification.
  • Prior experience delivering ERP modernization, cloud platform, or enterprise data programs.
  • Experience supporting production cutover planning and go/no-go readiness coordination.
  • Prior consulting or professional services delivery experience.
  • Prior experience in the construction industry or managing construction-related technology projects (major plus).

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager - Boston
jobs.jd_full:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Strategic Program Manager (SPM) – Join Our World-Class Team at MISUMI Americas!

As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at MISUMI Americas, you’ll partner with leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches without sacrificing quality. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll bring deep expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every stage — from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment teams to scope, plan, and execute complex programs, ensuring products launch on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards. Your ability to align internal teams with customer goals will be central to delivering consistent, measurable value across the full product lifecycle.

Beyond program execution, you’ll play an active role in continuous improvement — identifying opportunities to refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that make MISUMI Americas an even stronger partner for its customers.

What You’ll Be Doing:

At MISUMI Americas you will be part of an innovative team that is redefining the future of manufacturing. If you’re excited by challenges, passionate about delivering customer success, and eager to continuously learn and grow, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.jd_full:
The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade’s onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade’s mission in value-based care.

Primary Duties

  1. Launch Program Management: Plan and manage assigned launch workstreams from definition through close-out, including scope, milestones, dependencies, and owners. Build the program plan and task structure for each workstream, sequencing work by business priority, available resources, and dependencies. Maintain the workstream backlog and status in the team’s tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Cloud Coach, Salesforce) so progress is visible without manual chasing. Identify and escalate risks and roadblocks early, with a proposed mitigation or options for the Sr. Director.

  2. Goal Measurement & Analytics: Define and monitor KPIs that show whether launch goals are being met, including follow-through and milestone completion rates. Analyze program and practice-level data (e.g., Tableau, Salesforce reporting) to surface opportunities, risks, and trends, and turn them into actionable recommendations. Prepare clear, decision-ready status updates and reporting for Implementation leadership and cross-functional partners. Account for data-capture limitations and changes over time when reading trends, so decisions are not driven by reporting artifacts.

  3. Stakeholder Management: Align Product, Implementation, Field, Sales, and Support on shared launch priorities and clear handoffs. Navigate competing priorities across internal teams and practice stakeholders while keeping launch objectives in focus. Articulate the business case and rationale (“why”) behind launch initiatives to leadership, internal teams, and practice-facing audiences. Apply working knowledge of value-based care and ACO models to connect launch work to Aledade’s broader business goals.

  4. AI-Enabled Operations & Process Support: Leverage automation and AI solutions to streamline reporting, minimize manual status tracking, and reduce operational overhead, sharing best practices across the team. Create and maintain standardized workstream templates, playbooks, and repeatable workflows to drive consistent program execution. Define operational guidelines and quality gates for AI-assisted workflows to ensure data accuracy, prevent tracking errors, and uphold long-term maintainability. Develop reusable prompt templates and workflow accelerators to empower the team and unlock capacity for high-impact program management. Proactively identify and propose process enhancements that drive operational efficiency.

  5. Coaching & Thought Partnership: Support Implementation team members on program-level challenges and help them connect their work to launch goals. Translate complex operational and program concepts into clear, accessible guidance. Contribute to cross-team initiatives, including interviewing and onboarding, as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field. Significant relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of educational requirements.

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in healthcare (program management, project management, or a related field.).

  • Demonstrated track record of managing multi-stakeholder programs or initiatives with competing priorities and tight timelines.

  • Working knowledge of ambulatory EHR environments and how they affect clinical workflows and data exchange.

  • Proficiency with program and project tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Salesforce, Tableau, or equivalent).

  • Willingness and ability to travel 10–25% to partner practices, cross-functional meetings, and Aledade headquarters as needed.

Preferred KSA’s

  • PMP or equivalent program/project management certification.

  • Change management certification or formal training (e.g., Prosci ADKAR).

  • Agile/Scrum methodology and sprint-based delivery.

  • AI-assisted program management tools, automated reporting, or API-based system integration.

  • ACO or value-based care program experience, with understanding of Promoting Interoperability and quality measure reporting.

  • Track record of influencing teams without direct authority.

Enterprise Program

  • Enterprise Project Lifecycle: Deep understanding of the end-to-end implementation process for high-value enterprise accounts, specifically within a SaaS or professional services environment, ideally population health or value-based care tools.

  • Organizational Dynamics: Knowledge of how to navigate complex corporate structures, identifying key decision-makers, influencers, and blockers within large-scale healthcare or legal practices (or similar professional verticals).

  • Conflict Resolution Methodologies: Understanding of various strategies to manage competing priorities and resolve friction between internal product/engineering teams and external client expectations.

  • Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate complex project statuses, technical requirements, and value propositions to diverse audiences, ranging from C-suite executives to end-user administrative staff.

  • Negotiation & Influence: Skilled at gaining buy-in for project timelines and process changes, ensuring that both the client and the internal delivery teams remain aligned on the scope of work.

  • Expectation Management: Expert at setting realistic milestones and proactively communicating potential risks or delays to maintain trust and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Adaptability: Ability to pivot communication styles and project strategies quickly based on the specific culture, needs, and feedback of different enterprise stakeholders.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to lead cross-functional internal teams (Product, Sales, Support) to ensure a unified front is presented to the client, ensuring all stakeholder needs are met without compromising internal resources.

  • EHR Ecosystem Standards: Familiarity with the technical and operational requirements for deploying third-party insights within EHR environments (ideally EpicCare Ambulatory), including an understanding of how these integrations impact clinical workflows and provider experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Occasional travel may be required (approximately 10-25%).

  • Environment: Extensive use of computers and keyboards; sitting for prolonged periods.
